extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians/authors preparing manuscripts for the Journal of the Australian Mathematical Society
extracted.subtask_description: Author instructions for preparing and submitting research articles to the Journal of the Australian Mathematical Society, describing the kinds of papers sought, length expectations, submission procedure, and preferences for exposition. Targeted at authors who will use the partner submission system to send manuscripts for peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality and quality
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal 'seeks to publish original, high-quality articles'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Papers should contain original research; the journal emphasizes high-quality mathematical and mathematical-statistics contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Moderate length
rubrics_metrics.description: Articles should be of moderate length: '15 - 35 pages'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should aim for manuscripts in the indicated page range; very short notes or extremely long papers may not fit the journal's scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wide interest
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal looks for articles of 'wide interest'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitted work should be likely to appeal beyond a tiny specialist audience and be of interest to a broad segment of the journal's readership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expository quality of introductions
rubrics_metrics.description: Papers 'with good introductions explaining the context, meaning and value of the results are preferred.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introductions should clearly explain background, motivation, the significance of results, and place the work in context so referees and readers can appreciate its contribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted article types — Research Article
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal 'accepts the following types of articles: Research Article'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For purposes of Gold Open Access funding the journal considers these article types to be research articles; this affects APC eligibility and classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of partner submission system
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors 'will need an account for the submission system, which is separate to your Cambridge Core account.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must register/login to the partner submission system to submit manuscripts; links to login and submission support pages are provided for help.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare your materials before submitting
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors are asked to 'review this journal's author instructions, particularly the preparing your materials page, before submitting your manuscript.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the detailed preparing-your-materials guidance (formatting, metadata, supplementary files) provided by the journal prior to using the submission system to avoid delays or rejection for improper formatting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions undergo peer review; clear exposition and completeness of proofs and argumentation will facilitate positive referee reports.
